caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a wine flagon, shown in varying shades of blue and purple. The flagon has a tall, elegant form with a bulbous body, a narrow neck, and a hinged lid topped with a finial. Its handle is elaborate, curving gracefully from below the lid to the midsection of the vessel, and it has a pronounced spout extending outward from the opposite side. Decorative bead-like elements adorn the edges along the lid and upper and lower sections of the body. The flagon stands on a short, fluted stem and a wide, round base, which is set atop a square platform. The background is a muted, textured wash of blue-gray, and some handwritten notation appears to the left of the flagon, including the words “WINE FLAGON,” measurements, and a signature. The drawing is framed by a beige border with visible stains and signs of age.
title: Silver Wine Flagon
